summary.zh: 清理未闭环事项，评估项目与承诺的健康度
summary.en: Close open loops and score commitment health

description.zh: 按清空、对齐、展望三个阶段走一遍每周复盘，盘出所有未闭环的事项，用清单逐项确认缺口，并给出承诺健康度评分。适合周末收尾、系统开始不信任，或复盘习惯中断后重新启动时使用，需要本地 Python 3 环境。
description.en: Runs a three-phase weekly review: inventories open loops, flags named gaps on a checklist and scores commitment health. Good for a weekly close, restarting a lapsed habit or when your system feels untrustworthy.
